current_task_corrections.correction: Change target_definition.threshold_source from 'all_data' to 'train_only'. The 95th-percentile threshold must be computed only on the training partition to prevent leaking the test set's distribution into the target definition.

Remove 'billed_amount' and 'allowed_amount' from feature_set.features. These are post-submission amount fields and constitute target leakage. Use only claim-arrival-time features: claim_type, cpt_category, place_of_service, provider_specialty, network_status, service_units, length_of_stay, er_flag, elective_flag, preventive_flag, auth_required_flag, primary_icd10_cm, drg_present.

Change preprocessing.fit_on from 'all_data' to 'train_only'. The encoder and scaler must be fitted exclusively on the training partition, then applied to test data, to prevent leaking training statistics into test-set preprocessing.
